subject: Linear Algebra
topic: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors of Linear Operators
syllabus_context: Unit IV: Spectral Theory and Matrix Diagonalization. Linear transformations, invariant subspaces, characteristic equation, computation of eigenvalues and eigenvectors, algebraic and geometric multiplicity, defective matrices, diagonalizability.
declared_learning_objective: Compute the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a 2x2 matrix, explain the geometric intuition of an eigenvector as an invariant direction under linear transformation, and solve the characteristic polynomial det(A - lambda I) = 0.

provenance.source: MIT OpenCourseWare 18.06 (Linear Algebra, Prof. Gilbert Strang)

recording_quality.known_observability_limitations: Chalkboard matrix calculations occasionally transcribed from spoken exposition.
